sam_sales: Prospect Orion submitted a CAIQ (attached). We need someone to own answers + an ETA. POC kickoff target: next Tue. https://files.redwood/orion/CAIQ.xlsx

jordan_eng: Recommend: offer Hosted in eu with Redwood-managed keys for the POC and present Dedicated as the compliance-ready option. If they insist on BYOK for kickoff, we'll need to delay until Dedicated provisioning completes.
mia_security: @jordan_eng please provide a 2-3 sentence blurb I can paste into the CAIQ about BYOK status and Dedicated lead time.
sec_ops_bot: Compliance artifacts available (redacted): https://vault/reports/SOC2-2025-redacted.pdf and https://vault/reports/ISO27001-summary.pdf
eli_se: Pricing sketch: Hosted = usage-based (tokens/embeddings). Dedicated = capacity commit + onboarding fee. I'll produce concrete numbers once POC scope confirmed.
sam_sales: Also asked about whether telemetry/diagnostic logs will leave EU region.
jordan_eng: EU-hosted endpoints available. Telemetry needed for debugging may be routed to control plane; we can scope dataflow and DPA clauses. Strict residency & isolation → Dedicated.
